replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Looking at the first picture I can already see this might be a lot of work.

The iron farm (http://i.imgur.com/unW9pRF.png) looks very very small and if it doesn't go underground or the iron regenerates, it will be gone with the first armor run. There is also diamonds on the map that might make the gameplay unbalanced because of the amount. Not a lot of iron against full diamond people will be horrible.

The map layout it self is pretty weird TBH. I don't like the bridges you have made that go to the middle island. I think removing the bridges and making the middle island bigger as well as making a bigger void gap could work. I also dislike the "chunkyness" of the map. No curves just straight diagonals dont look nice. The map is also very very flat for its size without counting the bridges, There is also minimalistic / no cover at frontlines for archers.

Just with the blocks you used I have a couple issues. IMO stained clay on the sides of the islands make the map looks very very crappy. The covered monuments also look a bit weird due to the stained clay. Making the monument platforms more circular and removing the stained clay around it, would be a huge improvement.

This map has a lot of potential when it comes to the layout and design but overall its pretty bad in its current state.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Ah. In that case the iron amount is fine but everything else still stands. Even with a small amount of diamonds the gameplay can get unbalanced very fast and turn from good to horrible. 

"If everything is circle, something has to be square"

Rounding your map would make it look a lot better. Even if all other maps have rounded corners that doesn't mean you should go any make it all square to do something other maps don't have as it turns out horrible. Having everything diagonal like that is not only a downside to the looks but could also affect gameplay in a negative way.

Do what you want since its your map but these are just a couple tips that could hugely improve it.
